jobs.description:
Looking for a full-time or parttime warehouse job?

 Do you like to stay active and don't mind working hard? Then this job at GXO Logistics in Tilburg could be perfect for you.

You will work in a modern warehouse with an international team. Every day you help make sure customer orders are ready on time.

Please note: This is active, physical work. You will walk, stand and move all day.

What will you do?

You can work in different departments.

Order Picking:

- Pick products with a hand scanner.
- Collect the correct items for customer orders.

Packing:

- Scan the products.
- Check if the order is complete.
- Print shipping labels.
- Prepare packages for shipment.

Returns:

- Check returned products.
- Decide if the product can go back into stock.
- Process the return in the system.

Morning shift: 06:00 - 14:45

Afternoon shift: 06:00 - 14:45 and 15:15 - 00:00

You and your team make sure all products are handled carefully from the moment they arrive until they leave the warehouse.

What do we ask?

- You speak and understand basic English (minimum B1).
- You are available full-time or Partime.
- You like active work and are physically fit.
- You can stand and walk during your shift.
- You have your own accommodation and transport.
- You can apply for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG).

- Sales & Project Coordinator 
 Netherlands Full-time Mid-level - Quotation support - Project coordination - Client liaison 
As Sales & Project Coordinator you keep noise-reduction projects running smoothly from the first quotation to final delivery. You are the organisational backbone between sales, engineering, production and the customer: preparing quotations, processing orders, tracking progress and making sure everyone is working to the same scope and schedule. It's a role for someone who likes order, communicates clearly and enjoys being the person who keeps things on track. What you'll do - Prepare and follow up quotations together with the sales and engineering teams. - Process orders and keep project and customer data accurate in our systems. - Coordinate scope, schedule and information flow between sales, engineering and production. - Be a day-to-day contact for customers on order status, documentation and logistics. - Track milestones, flag delays early, and help keep projects on plan. - Support the sales team with reporting, follow-ups and administration. What you bring - An MBO/HBO-level education and a few years in sales support, project coordination or order management. - Strong organisational skills and an eye for detail. - Confidence with ERP/CRM systems and the standard office tools. - Clear, friendly communication with customers and colleagues. - The ability to juggle several projects without dropping the ball. - Professional Dutch and English. What we offer - A central role with visibility across the whole project lifecycle. - A friendly, collaborative team and short communication lines. - Room to grow towards project management or account management. - Competitive salary and benefits, plus the possibility of a permanent contract. 
Interested? Use Apply for this role below to send your CV, or email careers@axces.com .

Your responsibilities
- Review of changes in contract management system by Customer Services Coordinators.
- Timely invoicing of sales orders of assigned customers/regions.
- Flag deviations from company billing matrix to reduce & control exceptions in billing process.
- Investigate & follow up of customer queries/complaints about invoices.
- Work closely with the commercial & the credit & collections team.
- Act as an advisor for all Billing / Order to Cash activities.
- Open to work on continuous improvements in billing process.
- Prepare ad hoc overviews on billing for commercial teams and/or group finance.
- Ensure proper filing of customer communication & correspondence for audit purposes

What do you bring?
- Team player and comfortable in a multicultural and international environment.
- Must possess and demonstrate a high degree of integrity.
- Commitment to continuous improvement.
- Strong communication, analytical and organization skills.
- Experience with establishing and maintaining effective work relationships.
- Ability to effectively cope with change and multi-task.
- Must be organized, detail oriented and able to efficiently function under pressure and produce detailed, error-free work within limited timeframes.
What you also bring
- MBO degree in accounting or business.
- Minimum +2 years working in a similar position.
- Experience of Microsoft Dynamics 365 is an asset.
- Skilled in Microsoft Office with advanced Excel skills.
- Good command of the English language, both written and spoken.

Suus Plesman, wife of KLM founder Albert Plesman, quietly shaped history through hospitality. In the 1930s, as tensions rose between Albert and his pilots, Suus had a simple idea: invite everyone to the table for a home-cooked meal and a glass of wine, with one rule: no one leaves until peace is made. That dinner led to a historic agreement that helped define KLM's future, thanks to Suus' warmth and belief in the power of food to unite.  Today, Restaurant Suus carries on her legacy, bringing people together through shared stories and exceptional meals.  We are looking for a Kitchen Trainee to join our team in our brand-new kitchen.
